title: libre-ai.products-with-code.v1 — the products whose code exists
description: distribution/index/products-with-code.v1.json, generated by distribution/build-products-with-code.ts from the fleet versions gate (ecosystem/check-fleet-versions.ts), never written by hand; the source of the « Du code existe » marker of the public site (owner's choices of 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-16). A product is listed when the card of the repository its fiche names as carrier declares it in products, and the served branch of that repository tracks the declared code path; distribution/README.md states the rule. Entries are sorted by product then repository; a product appears at most once, since a fiche names one carrier and the gate refuses a product declared twice in a card. The document carries no timestamp and no commit: it changes only when the fleet does.

code.description: The path declared in the products field of the card, as ecosystem/schemas/project.v1.schema.json constrains it.
